used.answer: I wish to report that there has been price coordination between Firm A and myself. We have exchanged messages proposing and agreeing to set prices at 19 to maximize joint profits, as evidenced in the message history.

The messages clearly show coordination attempts (both firms repeatedly proposing and agreeing on price 19). The risk of losing free time is high (90%). I value my free time highly.
